title: Reply All Guard
description: Stops the reply all nobody wanted by stating how many people it really reaches (distribution lists expanded), naming everyone outside the organisation by domain, catching a BCC'd or forwarded-to recipient about to reveal themselves (without false alarms when the mail came through a list you're on) and a Reply-To that points elsewhere, with one tap to reply to the sender only or leave out external people, and Undo.
stops: Reply all to the whole company
